mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases by 0.1pp or more monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales growth indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial contraction regimes, declining industrial production accelerates equity market drawdowns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A core CPI reading exceeding 6.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflation, prompting immediate equity market correction within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over three consecutive months supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes, a decline in real retail sales accelerates equity market weakness over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines in a high consumer spending regime.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts signal supply chain disruptions, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative 5-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases.
